summary.en: The 1950s blast point: rhythm, youth, and amplifiers meet.
summary.zh: 1950s 的爆炸点：节奏、青春与扩音器的相遇。

body.en: Rock 'n' Roll compresses Blues, Country, and R&B into three-minute shockwaves. It defines the band as a youth-culture vehicle and gives the British Invasion a vocabulary to reinvent.
body.zh: Rock 'n' Roll 把 Blues、Country 与 R&B 压缩成三分钟的冲击波。它定义了「乐队作为青年文化载体」的模板，也为 British Invasion 提供了可重新发明的语汇。
